correction.decision: Remove the transcript-specific route, metadata, role, Viz, content spec and QA; preserve this ledger only as a failure record.

objective: Compile a user-provided three-hour Korean AI landscape transcript into a source-responsible technical article that teaches mechanisms, routes each claim to primary evidence and existing foundations, and does not grow the required curriculum without a genuine mechanism delta.

source_contract.input: User-provided timestamped Korean transcript, approximately 3 hours 3 minutes.
source_contract.url_policy: Do not invent or imply a video URL. Timestamps identify only positions in the supplied transcript.
excluded_from_fact_layer: claims about executive intent or private company strategy

reader_contract.transfer_problem: Given a fixed-budget 8B-model product that needs a long-context agent, an on-device helper, and a possible robot extension, classify MoE, 1.58-bit weights, Mamba, test-time compute, RAG, V-JEPA, and on-device inference by compute, memory traffic, data, verifier, and environment-feedback bottlenecks; then design the smallest useful experiments.
required_insights: parameter count, active compute, stored bytes, transferred bytes, and latency are different quantities
post-training and test-time search occur at different times and require different evidence
agent quality is a system property of model, context, tools, state, and evaluator
world-model understanding, prediction, and planning are distinct contracts
a new source extends the lower curriculum only when it introduces a reusable mechanism the existing floor cannot explain

primary_sources.intent: Verify the selective state-space alternative and avoid claiming universal Transformer replacement.

primary_sources.source: Better & Faster Large Language Models via Multi-token Prediction
primary_sources.intent: Anchor multi-token prediction as a specific training and decoding proposal.

primary_sources.intent: Separate ternary weights from generic post-training quantization.
Use a concrete native low-bit training report while preserving hardware and workload boundaries.
Anchor reasoning post-training and distillation claims to an official release rather than the transcript's interpretation.

primary_sources.intent: Separate inference-time compute allocation from training-time learning.

primary_sources.source: Textbooks Are All You Need II
primary_sources.intent: Ground synthetic textbook data in a bounded research result rather than a universal data-quality rule.
Distinguish workflows from autonomous agent loops and expose orchestration tradeoffs.
Ground retrieval improvements in a concrete reported setup.
Show that retrieval design extends beyond naive nearest-neighbor lookup without declaring one universal RAG architecture.

primary_sources.intent: Separate video representation, prediction, and planning claims and preserve the reported robot setup boundary.
Anchor on-device techniques to an official model and runtime description.
Connect cache and quantization claims to inference memory and throughput constraints.

events.observed: The transcript mixes paper-derived mechanisms, personal engineering experience, current market claims, forecasts, and informal commentary, and no exact video URL was supplied.
events.inference: A chronological summary would erase evidence boundaries and could turn unstable or speculative claims into apparent facts.
events.decision: Treat the transcript as a source synthesis, label evidence status per claim, hold volatile claims, and never fabricate the video link.
events.verification: The article opens with a source contract and the Viz exposes verified, partially supported, and held states.

events.observed: The same mechanism appears at distant timestamps and adjacent timestamps often change from technology to employment or personal opinion.
events.inference: Transcript order is optimized for a live conversation, not for cumulative technical learning.
events.decision: Reconstruct five mechanism axes and write problem -> mechanism -> evidence -> boundary -> existing-route sections.
events.verification: Eight article sections progress from classification through architecture, reasoning, agents, world models, infrastructure, and the curriculum decision.

events.observed: Every accepted mechanism already maps to existing architecture, post-training, agent, world-model, robot, or serving foundations.
events.inference: Creating one required article per named paper would duplicate concepts and restart unbounded historical recursion.
events.decision: Add this synthesis above existing routes and add no lower foundation node.
events.verification: The delta Viz sends all five axes to current-landscape integration and records zero foundation deltas.

events.observed: A static five-column map would be too dense on mobile and would not keep transcript claim, primary evidence, invariant, boundary, and route visible together.
events.inference: The stable unit is one claim axis, selected through a segmented control.
events.decision: Build five keyboard-accessible modes with a responsive one- or two-column evidence layout and a separate curriculum-delta gate.
events.verification: All modes switch at 360, 390, 768, and 1440 pixels with no document or Viz horizontal overflow.

events.observed: The two-part KV-cache formula intermittently exceeded its 360-pixel container by about five pixels.
events.inference: One display line contained both the allocation equation and the decoded-token scaling rule, forcing an unnecessary width competition.
events.decision: Split the operations into two aligned rows while preserving symbol identities and Korean underbraces.
events.verification: Five display formulas render as KaTeX with Korean role annotations, FormulaNotes, no raw LaTeX, and no material horizontal overflow across four viewports.

events.observed: The primary-evidence label in the compact Viz was truncated on narrow screens.
events.inference: A single-line flex and truncate rule treated the source name as decorative metadata even though it is part of the evidence contract.
events.decision: Allow the evidence label to wrap in an inline grid.
events.verification: The full source label remains readable in mobile screenshots without widening the card.

events.observed: The synthesis lived in the overall-map subcategory but its research-* slug caused the generic listing to hide it inside optional primary evidence and ArticleLayout labeled it SOURCE DEEP DIVE.
events.inference: The article's actual role is neither a required foundation nor one reconstructed primary source; it is the changing landscape layer between the stable map and goal-specific routes.
events.decision: Add an explicit current-landscape article role and rebuild the overall-map page as 00 shared map -> 01 current landscape -> 02 six target routes.
events.verification: The synthesis is always visible after the map, its article coordinate reads NOW / CURRENT LANDSCAPE, six destination rows follow it, and mobile/desktop screenshots show a stable hierarchy without overflow.
